name: @esuiss/access
description: Access TypeScript SDK: auth (OIDC client, PKCE, DPoP, refresh single-flight) and authorize (PEP decisions and receipt verification). Kernel semantics come from the Access Kernel compiled to WebAssembly.

scripts.gen: openapi-typescript ../openapi/access-v1.json -o src/generated/access-v1.ts && openapi-typescript ../openapi/admin-v1.json -o src/generated/admin-v1.ts && openapi-typescript ../openapi/frontend.json -o src/generated/frontend.ts && openapi-typescript ../openapi/login.json -o src/generated/login.ts
